blocks.question_text: Какой набор NFR корректен для Pastebin при миллионах DAU?

options.label: A
options.text: Read-heavy 100:1, p99 view < 100 ms cached, p99 create < 500 ms, 99.9% uptime, durability важна но не nines-of-9, TTL 30 дней-5 лет.

sections.explanation: Pastebin — read-heavy: paste просматривается десятки/сотни раз. Latency view критичнее create. 99.9% (8h/yr downtime) приемлемо т.к. не finance. Durability — потеря paste разочарование но не катастрофа. TTL — большинство pastes недолговечны.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com` декларирует 99.9% SLA. `GitHub Gist` 99.95% в составе GitHub.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой code/text sharing service: Pastebin, GitHub Gist, Hastebin.
sections.edge_cases: Burn-after-read требует атомарного view+delete. Multi-region GDPR — отдельный slot для EU residency.
sections.related: Q2 capacity; Q3 SLA; Q14 TTL.

options.label: B
options.text: Strong consistency на всех endpoints, 99.99% обязательно, write-heavy, p99 create < 50 ms, 11 nines durability.

sections.what_actually: Pastebin read-heavy 100:1. 99.99% overkill для text-sharing. p99 create < 50 ms нереалистично из-за валидации+anti-abuse. 11 nines = банк-уровень.
sections.source_of_confusion: Кандидат экстраполирует финтех-требования на простой text-sharing.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 11 nines, GitHub Gist держал бы 3+ datacenters с erasure coding — реально single-region S3 достаточно.
sections.how_it_should_be: Read-heavy + 99.9% + practical durability. Pastebin read-heavy 100:1.

options.label: C
options.text: Eventual consistency даже для metadata, p99 view < 1 сек, no TTL, no anti-abuse — open platform.

sections.what_actually: Eventual на metadata → paste после create может не отображаться → bad UX. p99 1 сек медленно (стандарт 100 ms). No TTL = unlimited storage growth. No anti-abuse → DMCA lawsuits.
sections.source_of_confusion: Кандидат смешивает 'eventual для cache' с 'eventual для primary write'.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы no anti-abuse, Pastebin закрыли бы по суду за copyrighted leaks.
sections.how_it_should_be: Strong на metadata; TTL обязательна; anti-abuse mandatory.

options.label: D
options.text: Anonymous-only, public по умолчанию, single Postgres для всего. Modern Pastebin поддерживает auth + privacy modes.

sections.what_actually: Modern Pastebin поддерживает auth + privacy modes. Single Postgres не масштабируется на TB content.
sections.source_of_confusion: Кандидат описывает 2005-era Pastebin. Modern Pastebin поддерживает auth + privacy modes.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы all public, любой leaked secret в Google за минуты.
sections.how_it_should_be: Anonymous + auth oba; privacy modes; metadata/blob separation.

blocks.question_text: Какая capacity estimation корректна для Pastebin при 1M pastes/day и 5-year retention?

options.label: A
options.text: 100 GB raw blob, 10 GB metadata, single Redis достаточен, CDN не нужен. 1M × 10 KB × 365 × 5 = 18 TB, не 100 GB.

sections.what_actually: 1M × 10 KB × 365 × 5 = 18 TB, не 100 GB. Single Redis = SPOF + memory limit. CDN критичен (95% hit) иначе bandwidth $$$.
sections.source_of_confusion: Недооценка retention или среднего размера. 1M × 10 KB × 365 × 5 = 18 TB, не 100 GB.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 100 GB, single VPS хватало бы — реально десятки серверов.
sections.how_it_should_be: 18 TB raw → 5-7 TB compressed; multi-tier storage; CDN.

options.label: B
options.text: 1M × 10 KB × 5 лет = 18 TB raw → 5-7 TB zstd; metadata 100 GB; views 6K QPS peak; CDN 95%+ hit ratio критичен.

sections.explanation: 1M × 365 × 5 = 1.8B pastes. Average 10 KB → raw 18 TB; zstd 3-4× → 5-7 TB. Metadata ~50 байт × 1.8B = ~100 GB. Read-heavy 100:1 = 100M views/day = 1200 QPS average, peak ×5 = 6K. CDN 95% hit → origin 300 QPS.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com` ~10 PB на S3+CDN. `GitHub Gist` — Git CAS dedup.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой text-sharing с long-tail content и hot top-N.
sections.edge_cases: Tiered storage: hot 30 дней Redis + 5 лет S3 + Glacier. Compression: code 5×, JSON 4×, base64 2×.
sections.related: Q5 storage separation; Q7 zstd; Q22 tiering; Q23 CDN.

options.label: C
options.text: 100 PB raw — paste'ы большие (10 MB avg). 10 MB avg нереалистично. Путает Dropbox (MB-GB files) с Pastebin (KB snippets).

sections.what_actually: 10 MB avg нереалистично. Hard limit 512 KB free / 10 MB Pro. Average 5-15 KB по Pastebin.com data.
sections.source_of_confusion: Путает Dropbox (MB-GB files) с Pastebin (KB snippets).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 100 PB, экономика не сходится ($2M+/month storage).
sections.how_it_should_be: Pastes KB scale (10 KB avg), max 10 MB ограничение.

options.label: D
options.text: 1 PB raw, 100K writes/sec, 1M views/sec, 50 PB CDN/day. 1M/day = 12 writes/sec, не 100K.

sections.what_actually: 1M/day = 12 writes/sec, не 100K. Views peak 6K QPS не 1M (это YouTube). 50 PB/day = 6 GB/sec — реально 60 MB/sec.
sections.source_of_confusion: Завышение на 3-4 порядка. 1M/day = 12 writes/sec, не 100K.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 100K writes/sec, Pastebin был бы №2 после YouTube — реально нишевой.
sections.how_it_should_be: 12 writes/sec, 6K QPS peak, 5-7 TB blob, 100 GB metadata.

blocks.question_text: Какие SLO определяют операционное здоровье Pastebin?

options.label: A
options.text: Только availability 99.9% и create success rate > 95%. Two metrics недостаточно. Только uptime = observability.

sections.what_actually: Two metrics недостаточно. Latency не отслеживается → users видят 5-сек p99 без alert. CDN hit ratio не tracked → bandwidth blow up. GC lag → storage growth.
sections.source_of_confusion: Только uptime = observability. Two metrics недостаточно.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только uptime, Twitch 2018 latency degradation был бы 'нормальным'.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-dimensional: latency p99 + hit ratio + success + GC lag.

options.label: B
options.text: p50/p95/p99/p99.9/p99.99 для всех endpoints. Too many percentiles = paralysis. Overengineers measurement. p50/p95/p99 для key endpoints — оптимально.

sections.what_actually: Too many percentiles = paralysis. SRE стандарт: p50 + p99. p99.99 на 6K QPS = 6 событий/min, статистический шум.
sections.source_of_confusion: Overengineers measurement. Too many percentiles = paralysis.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы all percentiles, dashboards unreadable. Too many percentiles = paralysis.
sections.how_it_should_be: p50/p95/p99 для key endpoints — оптимально. Too many percentiles = paralysis.

options.label: C
options.text: Creation p99 < 500 ms, view p99 < 100 ms cached, CDN hit > 90%, expiration GC lag < 60 min, abuse block rate ratio, success > 99%, availability 99.9%.

sections.explanation: Multi-dimensional. Create включает validation + anti-abuse + blob write + metadata insert. View < 100 ms cached — main user path. CDN > 90% — origin не перегружен. GC lag показывает blob storage growth rate. Abuse block rate diagnostic — spike = coordinated attack.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com Statuspage`. `GitHub Status` partial outages on Gist отдельно.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой content-sharing с CDN; alerting per metric. Multi-dimensional.
sections.edge_cases: Sampling: при low QPS p99 шумит — sliding window 1 hour. CDN hit ratio ~100% подозрительно (cache validation broken).
sections.related: Q22 storage tiering; Q23 CDN; Q25 anti-abuse.

options.label: D
options.text: Только business metrics: DAU, retention, monetization. Product analytics, не operational. Смешивает PM perspective с SRE.

sections.what_actually: Product analytics, не operational. Без latency/availability tracking operational issues invisible до fallout.
sections.source_of_confusion: Смешивает PM perspective с SRE. Product analytics, не operational.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только DAU, 2-часовой downtime замечен после DAU drop (часы delay).
sections.how_it_should_be: Operational SLO + business metrics обе нужны. Product analytics, не operational.

blocks.question_text: Какая стратегия generation short URL для Pastebin?

options.label: A
options.text: Auto-increment counter Postgres `INSERT...RETURNING id` → Base62. Sequential IDs → **enumerable** URLs `/1`.

sections.what_actually: Sequential IDs → **enumerable** URLs `/1`, `/2` — scrapers переберут весь corpus, leak `unlisted` paste. Counter = bottleneck (write lock на sequence).
sections.source_of_confusion: Знает что counter простой, не security. Sequential IDs → **enumerable** URLs `/1`, `/2` — scrapers переберут весь corpus, leak `unlisted` paste.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы sequential, Pastebin scandal с массовым leak.
sections.how_it_should_be: Random Base62 с UNIQUE retry. Sequential IDs → **enumerable** URLs `/1`, `/2` — scrapers переберут весь corpus, leak `unlisted` paste.

options.label: B
options.text: MD5(content)[:7] — детерминированный hash от content. Детерминированный → privacy leak (same content = same URL).

sections.what_actually: Детерминированный → privacy leak (same content = same URL). 7 chars Base62 = 3.5T, collision на ~6B items возможны. MD5 broken.
sections.source_of_confusion: Хочет dedup-free dedup. Детерминированный → privacy leak (same content = same URL).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы content-addressable, secret `API_KEY=xyz` имел бы guessable URL.
sections.how_it_should_be: Random без content derivation. Детерминированный → privacy leak (same content = same URL).

options.label: C
options.text: UUID v4 (32 hex chars) для max unpredictability. 32 chars URL не 'short' — гадость для UX (`pastebin.

sections.what_actually: 32 chars URL не 'short' — гадость для UX (`pastebin.com/550e8400-e29b...`). Pastebin 8 chars Base62 = 218T хватает.
sections.source_of_confusion: Переусердствует на security, теряя core feature. 32 chars URL не 'short' — гадость для UX (`pastebin.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы UUID, embed widgets / mobile share — chains of gibberish.
sections.how_it_should_be: Base62 7-8 chars оптимально. 32 chars URL не 'short' — гадость для UX (`pastebin.

options.label: D
options.text: Random Base62 7-8 chars из `[A-Za-z0-9]` с UNIQUE + retry; 62^7 = 3.5T combinations, при 6B real pastes collision ~0.2%.

sections.explanation: `crypto/rand` для каждого paste. Alphabet `[A-Za-z0-9]` 62 × 7 = 3.5T combinations. 6B pastes использует 0.2% пространства — collision вероятность 10^-12, handled UNIQUE retry. Unpredictable (security) + readable + short.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com` 8 chars; `Hastebin` 10; `Bitly` 7; `GitHub Gist` 32 hex.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой short URL service. `crypto/rand` для каждого paste.
sections.edge_cases: Уменьшение до 6 chars (62^6 = 56B) рискованно при scale (collision ~10%). UNIQUE retry: после 3 fail — bump 9 chars. Crypto-secure vs `Math.random` — crypto обязательно.
sections.related: Q5 storage UNIQUE; design-url-shortener Q4 параллель.

blocks.question_text: Как разделить storage Pastebin между metadata и blob?

options.label: A
options.text: Metadata в Postgres (paste_id, user_id, lang, timestamps, visibility, expires_at), blob в S3 по ключу `pastes/{short_code}.zst`.

sections.explanation: Стандарт для content-sharing. Metadata: structured, ACID (UNIQUE short_code, transactions для visibility), индексы (`WHERE user_id`). Blob: immutable, CDN-able, дешёво S3 ($0.023/GB-month vs Postgres $0.10+/GB). S3 key = short_code + extension для compression algo.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com` MySQL + S3 (Amazon RDS + S3). `GitHub Gist` Git CAS storage. `Hastebin` Redis + MongoDB.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой content-sharing service. Стандарт для content-sharing.
sections.edge_cases: Orphan blobs: если metadata insert fails after blob upload — фоновый job. Multi-region — S3 cross-region replication.
sections.related: Q6 schema; Q22 tiering; design-dropbox Q6 параллель.

options.label: B
options.text: Всё в одном Postgres: content в TEXT column. 10 KB blob в TEXT → Postgres TOAST + heap bloat.

sections.what_actually: 10 KB blob в TEXT → Postgres TOAST + heap bloat. 60 TB Postgres → repl/backup нерационально.
sections.source_of_confusion: Игнорирует storage cost / performance tradeoff. 10 KB blob в TEXT → Postgres TOAST + heap bloat.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы single Postgres, `VACUUM FULL` стал бы недопустим на multi-TB.
sections.how_it_should_be: Разделение metadata + blob. 10 KB blob в TEXT → Postgres TOAST + heap bloat.

options.label: C
options.text: Всё в Redis: blob + metadata. Snapshot в S3 для backup. 60 TB в Redis = $$$. Хочет low latency, забывая cost.

sections.what_actually: 60 TB в Redis = $$$. Volatility — snapshots раз в час теряют до часа creates.
sections.source_of_confusion: Хочет low latency, забывая cost. 60 TB в Redis = $$$.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Redis primary, расходы > выручка. 60 TB в Redis = $$$.
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis как cache, не primary. Если бы Redis primary, расходы > выручка.

options.label: D
options.text: MongoDB single storage: документ с blob + metadata + indexes. MongoDB на 60 TB sharded возможен, но cost roughly 2-3× S3+Postgres.

sections.what_actually: MongoDB на 60 TB sharded возможен, но cost roughly 2-3× S3+Postgres. UNIQUE constraint requires unique index.
sections.source_of_confusion: MongoDB scales horizontally, но для structured Postgres лучше.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы MongoDB-only, costs выше при equal capacity.
sections.how_it_should_be: Postgres metadata + S3 blob — industry standard. MongoDB на 60 TB sharded возможен, но cost roughly 2-3× S3+Postgres.

blocks.question_text: Какая schema Postgres для Pastebin сбалансирована для функций и query performance?

options.label: A
options.text: Одна таблица `pastes` со всеми полями: views/comments в JSON column, edit history в JSON array. JSON column не масштабируется — views per popular paste = миллионы records, cannot index.

sections.what_actually: JSON column не масштабируется — views per popular paste = миллионы records, cannot index. Edit history в array → последнее состояние, без timestamps/diff.
sections.source_of_confusion: Хочет 'one table fits all'. JSON column не масштабируется — views per popular paste = миллионы records, cannot index.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы JSON array на 100K views, single row мегабайтный.
sections.how_it_should_be: Нормализованная: pastes, paste_views partitioned, revisions, comments.

options.label: B
options.text: Pastes (PK short_code), users (PK user_id), paste_views (partitioned by month), paste_revisions, paste_comments (FK к pastes); indexes (user_id, created_at), (expires_at) WHERE NOT NULL.

sections.explanation: Нормализованная multi-table. short_code natural PK для O(1) lookup. `paste_views` partitioned by month → cleanup OLD analytics через `DROP PARTITION` (не DELETE на миллиардах). `paste_revisions` для Gist editing с timestamps. Partial index на `expires_at WHERE NOT NULL` экономит размер.
sections.example: `GitHub Gist` schema аналогична (gists, revisions, comments). `Pastebin.com` MySQL похожий.
sections.when_to_apply: Content service с time-series analytics + versioning + threads.
sections.edge_cases: Sharding by user_id или short_code prefix если single Postgres не хватает. Partition pruning critical иначе query сканит все месяцы.
sections.related: Q5 storage; Q14 expires_at; Q16 revisions.

options.label: C
options.text: Только `pastes` — без views/comments/revisions. Modern Pastebin включает analytics + comments + revisions. Видит 2005-era Pastebin. Multi-table с analytics + versioning + comments.

sections.what_actually: Modern Pastebin включает analytics + comments + revisions. Без них продукт неконкурентен.
sections.source_of_confusion: Видит 2005-era Pastebin. Modern Pastebin включает analytics + comments + revisions.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы no analytics, Trending tab невозможен; без edit — Gist usecase impossible.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-table с analytics + versioning + comments. Modern Pastebin включает analytics + comments + revisions.

options.label: D
options.text: DynamoDB вместо RDBMS: short_code → blob, user_id → profile. DynamoDB хорош для primary key access, но 'my pastes ORDER BY created_at' требует GSI (cost), 'all expired' нет efficient scan.

sections.what_actually: DynamoDB хорош для primary key access, но 'my pastes ORDER BY created_at' требует GSI (cost), 'all expired' нет efficient scan. Cost при scale × 3-5 vs Postgres.
sections.source_of_confusion: Хочет 'serverless DB'. DynamoDB хорош для primary key access, но 'my pastes ORDER BY created_at' требует GSI (cost), 'all expired' нет efficient scan.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы DynamoDB, ORDER BY query — expensive GSI scan.
sections.how_it_should_be: Postgres primary; DynamoDB optional для simple cases.

blocks.question_text: Какой compression алгоритм для Pastebin blob на write?

options.label: A
options.text: Gzip level 9 — максимальное сжатие. Gzip -9 ratio 2. Максимальный ratio = лучший выбор. zstd: лучше ratio + быстрее.

sections.what_actually: Gzip -9 ratio 2.5× на текст, encode ~10 MB/s. Slower writes; cumulative CPU cost.
sections.source_of_confusion: Максимальный ratio = лучший выбор. Gzip -9 ratio 2.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы gzip -9, write throughput падал бы → backpressure на API spikes.
sections.how_it_should_be: zstd: лучше ratio + быстрее. Если бы gzip -9, write throughput падал бы → backpressure на API spikes.

options.label: B
options.text: LZ4 — самый быстрый, ratio ~1.5×. LZ4 быстрый (500 MB/s) но ratio 1. Выбирает скорость, не учитывая storage > CPU cost.

sections.what_actually: LZ4 быстрый (500 MB/s) но ratio 1.5× → 18 TB → 12 TB (мало saving). zstd 3-4× при 400 MB/s.
sections.source_of_confusion: Выбирает скорость, не учитывая storage > CPU cost.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы LZ4, storage bill 2× при незначительном CPU saving.
sections.how_it_should_be: zstd — баланс speed + ratio для текста. LZ4 быстрый (500 MB/s) но ratio 1.

options.label: C
options.text: Zstandard level 3 — ratio 3-4× на текст, encode 400 MB/s, decode 800 MB/s. Skip compression для already-compressed (детект magic bytes).

sections.explanation: zstd — современный стандарт. Level 3 default → ratio 3-4× на код/JSON/logs при 400 MB/s encode — write латентность negligible. Decode 800 MB/s. Skip для уже сжатого (base64, PNG/JPEG, gzip header) — детектируется magic bytes + Shannon entropy. Storage saving: 18 TB → 5 TB = $250/month saving.
sections.example: Facebook Zstandard 2016. GitHub использует zstd для repository compression. Cloudflare для web content.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая система с large text content: pastebin, logs, JSON dumps.
sections.edge_cases: Level tuning: 3 real-time; 19 batch. Multi-threaded -T0 для > 1 MB. Dictionary mode для similar pastes.
sections.related: Q8 raw endpoints; Q22 tiering; Q29 cost.

options.label: D
options.text: Brotli — highest ratio (4.5×), encode slow. Brotli level 11 highest ratio но encode ~10 MB/s. Если бы Brotli, write CPU dominate;

sections.what_actually: Brotli level 11 highest ratio но encode ~10 MB/s. Pastebin write rate 12/sec — Brotli работал бы, но zstd лучше на CPU economics.
sections.source_of_confusion: Browsers prefer Brotli (HTTP serving), но это не нужно для server-side storage.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Brotli, write CPU dominate; на edge можно decompress + re-encode.
sections.how_it_should_be: zstd storage; Brotli optionally на edge HTTP. Brotli level 11 highest ratio но encode ~10 MB/s.

blocks.question_text: Зачем `/raw/{short_code}` endpoint отдельно от `/{short_code}`?

options.label: A
options.text: Только для аналитики — `/raw` traffic отдельно. Аналитика — не main reason. Недопонимает дифференциацию.

sections.what_actually: Аналитика — не main reason. Главное: Content-Type, access pattern (programmatic vs browser), caching strategy.
sections.source_of_confusion: Недопонимает дифференциацию. Аналитика — не main reason.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только аналитика, можно trace via header. Аналитика — не main reason.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multiple reasons: Content-Type, caching, programmatic access.

options.label: B
options.text: Раздельные URLs для SEO. Pastebin не SEO-optimized. Думает SEO-terms. /raw programmatic, обычно noindex.

sections.what_actually: Pastebin не SEO-optimized. Google индексирует обе если linked. /raw обычно noindex для security.
sections.source_of_confusion: Думает SEO-terms.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы /raw SEO-optimized, content scraping вырос бы.
sections.how_it_should_be: /raw programmatic, обычно noindex. Pastebin не SEO-optimized.

options.label: C
options.text: Для legal — `/raw` имеет другие T&C. T&C одинаковые. Overthinks regulatory. Single T&C;

sections.what_actually: T&C одинаковые. Legal — product/policy, не technical separation.
sections.source_of_confusion: Overthinks regulatory.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы separate T&C, требовался бы separate consent.
sections.how_it_should_be: Single T&C; technical separation для другого. T&C одинаковые.

options.label: D
options.text: `/raw` возвращает `Content-Type: text/plain` для curl/wget/IDE plugins/terminal pipes;

sections.explanation: Разделение для разных consumer types. `/raw` text/plain — programmatic (curl, IDE plugins, terminal `curl ... | bash`). `/{short_code}` text/html с Pygments syntax highlighting + nav + comments. CDN caching: `/raw` aggressive cache (immutable), HTML может invalidate чаще. Programmatic clients не парсят HTML.
sections.example: `Pastebin.com` /raw/{id}. `GitHub Gist` /raw/{revision}/{filename}. `Hastebin` /raw/{key}.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая system с human (browser) + machine (CLI, API) consumers.
sections.edge_cases: Content negotiation alternative: один URL с `Accept: text/plain`. Но раздельные URLs проще для curl без custom headers.
sections.related: Q11 syntax highlighting; Q23 CDN.

blocks.question_text: Какой REST API contract для Pastebin create-paste?

options.label: A
options.text: POST /api/v1/pastes с `Idempotency-Key` header + `Authorization: Bearer {api_token}`; body JSON с content, language, expires_in, visibility;

sections.explanation: Idempotency-Key — Stripe-style. Client генерирует UUID, отправляет в header. Server хранит `(idempotency_key, response)` на 24h. Retry на network failure → cached response, не duplicate. Authorization Bearer — OAuth 2.0; tokens hashed на DB side. JSON body для structured request, language tag для server-side highlight.
sections.example: Stripe API популяризовал Idempotency-Key. GitHub Gist API использует PAT. Pastebin.com API — api_dev_key + api_user_key (legacy).
sections.when_to_apply: Любой API с side effects где duplicates вредны: payments, email send, paste create.
sections.edge_cases: TTL idempotency cache: 24h balance retry window + storage. Schema validation: language enum, visibility enum, expires_in numeric.
sections.related: Q26 API tokens; Q27 rate limiting.

options.label: B
options.text: Query parameters `POST /api/pastes?content=...&lang=...` без body, без auth. URL params для content fail при > 2-8 KB. GET-style HTTP для всех операций.

sections.what_actually: URL params для content fail при > 2-8 KB. Без auth → anonymous abuse, нет per-user quotas.
sections.source_of_confusion: GET-style HTTP для всех операций. URL params для content fail при > 2-8 KB.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы content в query, 90% pastes (>2 KB) не создавались.
sections.how_it_should_be: POST body + auth header. URL params для content fail при > 2-8 KB.

options.label: C

options.label: C

Mobile: client просто рендерит HTML без CPU. Pygments поддерживает 600+ языков. Client-side Prism — fallback для huge файлов (> 1 MB), languages не в Pygments, customized themes.

sections.source_of_confusion: Регулярки кажутся простыми. Regex не парсит HTML правильно.

CommonMark/GFM (GitHub Flavored Markdown) parses Markdown в HTML; Bleach/DOMPurify pass через whitelist allowed tags + atribs + URL schemes (no `javascript:`, `data:`). XSS защищён даже если markdown содержит `<script>` — sanitizer удаляет. Mermaid diagrams render отдельно через svg sanitization.
sections.example: GitHub использует custom GFM + sanitize-html. Markdown-it + DOMPurify — стандарт для JS. Bleach used by Mozilla MDN.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой user-content rendering: comments, pastes, blog posts.
sections.edge_cases: Allowlist слишком permissive (`style` attribute) = CSS injection. URL whitelist: `http`, `https`, `mailto` — не `javascript:`, `data:`. Custom tags для product: `<gist-embed>` requires server-side resolution before render.
sections.related: Q25 anti-abuse XSS detection.

blocks.question_text: Language detection для syntax highlighting — auto или explicit?

options.label: A
options.text: Hybrid: explicit user-selection в UI (dropdown 'Python', 'JavaScript', ...); если не указано — auto-detect через Pygments `guess_lexer` или GitHub Linguist ML; shebang line detection (`#!/usr/bin/python`) приоритет;

sections.explanation: Hybrid стратегия. UI dropdown для explicit (Pastebin показывает top 20 languages). Если user не выбрал — auto-detect: shebang line `#!` (highest priority, точно определяет), Pygments `guess_lexer` (Bayes-style scoring на keywords), GitHub Linguist ML (better quality, classifier с 600+ языками). Fallback plain text если confidence низкая. User overridable через URL `?lang=python`.
sections.example: GitHub использует Linguist для language detection в repos. Pastebin.com explicit dropdown + 'auto-detect' option. Hastebin client-side highlight.js auto-detect.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой code-sharing требует language tag для highlight + analytics.
sections.edge_cases: Mislabeled language → wrong highlight (Python vs Ruby — похожи). Mixed-language paste (HTML + JS + CSS) — приоритет содержимого `<script>`. Domain-specific languages (Cypher, GraphQL schema) — fallback на text.
sections.related: Q11 syntax highlight; Q18 search by language.

options.label: C

sections.source_of_confusion: Не учитывает quick-paste use case. Friction в UI: для quick paste users skip selection.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы explicit only, conversion rate creates падает (extra step).
sections.how_it_should_be: Default auto-detect с override. Friction в UI: для quick paste users skip selection.

blocks.question_text: Как реализовать TTL/expiration для pastes?

options.label: A
options.text: Cron job DELETE expired каждый день. Cron daily может оставить expired pastes accessible на сутки (privacy issue для burn-after-read). Простое решение через cron.

sections.what_actually: Cron daily может оставить expired pastes accessible на сутки (privacy issue для burn-after-read). На 1M pastes/day DELETE на S3 — большая операция. Storage GC lag растёт.
sections.source_of_confusion: Простое решение через cron. Cron daily может оставить expired pastes accessible на сутки (privacy issue для burn-after-read).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы daily cron, expired private paste viewable на 24h после deadline.
sections.how_it_should_be: On-read check + S3 lifecycle policy. Cron daily может оставить expired pastes accessible на сутки (privacy issue для burn-after-read).

options.label: B
options.text: Two-tier: (1) on-read check `expires_at < NOW()` → return 410 Gone, (2) S3 Lifecycle Policy auto-expire blob через `expires_at` tag (или DynamoDB TTL attribute);

sections.explanation: **On-read check** обеспечивает immediate enforcement: paste expired → 410 Gone immediately, даже если blob ещё на S3. **S3 Lifecycle Policy** — managed background deletion: tag blob с `expires_at=2026-06-01`, S3 автоматически удаляет items с tag после date. Metadata (Postgres rows) cleanup nightly через batch `DELETE WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'` (7-day grace для analytics queries). DynamoDB TTL attribute эквивалент — auto-delete items когда TTL attribute reached.
sections.example: Snapchat использует похожую модель для ephemeral messages. AWS S3 Lifecycle Rules для cost optimization. DynamoDB TTL attribute для auto-cleanup.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой content service с retention: Pastebin, Stories (Instagram, Snapchat), temp files.
sections.edge_cases: Grace period 7 days для analytics (last view count). Burn-after-read особый случай — atomic delete после view (Q15). Multi-region — replication перед deletion для consistency.
sections.related: Q15 burn-after-read; Q17 trash retention; Q22 storage tiering.

options.label: C
options.text: TTL через Redis EXPIRE — paste auto-удаляется из cache. Redis EXPIRE удаляет из cache, но primary blob на S3 остаётся forever. Cache TTL ≠ data TTL.

sections.what_actually: Redis EXPIRE удаляет из cache, но primary blob на S3 остаётся forever. Privacy issue + storage growth.
sections.source_of_confusion: Cache TTL ≠ data TTL. Redis EXPIRE удаляет из cache, но primary blob на S3 остаётся forever.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только Redis EXPIRE, S3 заполняется expired blobs.
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis cache + S3 lifecycle + on-read check. Redis EXPIRE удаляет из cache, но primary blob на S3 остаётся forever.

options.label: D
options.text: Не нужно TTL — keep all pastes forever (storage cheap). Storage cost растёт linearly. Storage cost не вечно cheap. TTL обязательна;

sections.what_actually: Storage cost растёт linearly. Privacy compliance (GDPR right-to-be-forgotten) требует deletion. Many pastes intended ephemeral (debugging snippets, secrets shared).
sections.source_of_confusion: Storage cost не вечно cheap. Storage cost растёт linearly.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы no TTL, на 5 лет accumulate 50 TB → $$$ storage bill.
sections.how_it_should_be: TTL обязательна; default 30 days for free tier. Storage cost растёт linearly.

blocks.question_text: Burn-after-reading paste — атомарное view + delete?

options.label: A
options.text: Просто DELETE после render. Race condition: два concurrent view → оба получают content, потом оба DELETE. Простое решение без concurrency awareness.

sections.what_actually: Race condition: два concurrent view → оба получают content, потом оба DELETE. Need atomic check-and-delete.
sections.source_of_confusion: Простое решение без concurrency awareness. Race condition: два concurrent view → оба получают content, потом оба DELETE.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы naive, leaked secret paste просматривался 2 раза до удаления.
sections.how_it_should_be: FOR UPDATE row lock или conditional update. Race condition: два concurrent view → оба получают content, потом оба DELETE.

options.label: B
options.text: Lock через app-level mutex. App-level mutex не работает на multi-instance servers (Pastebin behind load balancer). Не учитывает distributed system.

sections.what_actually: App-level mutex не работает на multi-instance servers (Pastebin behind load balancer). Distributed lock через Redis возможен, но дороже DB-native solution.
sections.source_of_confusion: Не учитывает distributed system. App-level mutex не работает на multi-instance servers (Pastebin behind load balancer).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы app-level lock, multi-instance app не координируется.
sections.how_it_should_be: DB row lock или Redis distributed lock. App-level mutex не работает на multi-instance servers (Pastebin behind load balancer).

options.label: C
options.text: Postgres transaction с `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` row lock + UPDATE delete flag в той же transaction. Атомарно: либо первый viewer получает content + paste marked deleted, либо second получает 404.

sections.explanation: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` блокирует row exclusive (другие SELECT FOR UPDATE wait). В transaction: SELECT content, проверить `viewed = false`; UPDATE viewed = true; COMMIT. Атомарность гарантирована Postgres. Concurrent views: первый wins, остальные waited на lock и видят `viewed = true` → 404. Альтернатива: `UPDATE ... WHERE viewed=false RETURNING content` (optimistic — атомарный CAS).
sections.example: 0bin использует client-side encryption + server delete. Privatebin аналогично. Pastebin Pro имеет burn-after-read feature.
sections.when_to_apply: Confidential temporary sharing: passwords, API keys, one-time messages.
sections.edge_cases: Crawler bots (Slack link preview, Twitter Card) trigger burn если access first — нужен whitelist для preview bots OR delay TTL after first view (2 min для preview). Logged-in user — другой view counted.
sections.related: Q14 expiration; Q17 trash; Q21 architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: Mark deleted в Redis cache, S3 blob удалить asynchronously. Если Redis crashed/restarted без persistence, paste 'reappears'. Cache-only solution без durability.

sections.what_actually: Если Redis crashed/restarted без persistence, paste 'reappears'. Async deletion S3 имеет lag — paste available через direct S3 URL короткое время.
sections.source_of_confusion: Cache-only solution без durability. Если Redis crashed/restarted без persistence, paste 'reappears'.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Redis-only, persistence issues + S3 lag = leak.
sections.how_it_should_be: Postgres transaction + immediate S3 delete. Если Redis crashed/restarted без persistence, paste 'reappears'.

blocks.question_text: Versioning pastes — как Gist-style edits?

options.label: A
options.text: Просто UPDATE content — последняя версия. UPDATE без history теряет previous versions. Простое решение без history. INSERT new revision row с version increment.

sections.what_actually: UPDATE без history теряет previous versions. Если paste accidentally overwritten, восстановить нельзя.
sections.source_of_confusion: Простое решение без history. UPDATE без history теряет previous versions.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы UPDATE-only, accidental overwrite irrevocable.
sections.how_it_should_be: INSERT new revision row с version increment. UPDATE без history теряет previous versions.

options.label: B
options.text: Хранить diffs (delta encoding) как Git. Diff storage возможен (Git approach), но для simple text pastes overhead complexity не нужен. Хочет Git-like efficiency. Full snapshots per revision проще для < 1 MB pastes.

sections.what_actually: Diff storage возможен (Git approach), но для simple text pastes overhead complexity не нужен. На небольших pastes (< 100 KB) полные snapshots проще + быстрее retrieve.
sections.source_of_confusion: Хочет Git-like efficiency. Diff storage возможен (Git approach), но для simple text pastes overhead complexity не нужен.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы delta encoding, retrieve требует replay diffs — slow.
sections.how_it_should_be: Full snapshots per revision проще для < 1 MB pastes.

options.label: C
options.text: Только последние 3 revisions retain. Arbitrary limit 3 — почему не 5?. Arbitrary product decision без user research. Unlimited (или по subscription) с storage cost monitoring.

sections.what_actually: Arbitrary limit 3 — почему не 5? 10? User expectation = unlimited history (Gist хранит forever).
sections.source_of_confusion: Arbitrary product decision без user research. Arbitrary limit 3 — почему не 5?
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 3 revisions, user который redo 4 раза теряет original.
sections.how_it_should_be: Unlimited (или по subscription) с storage cost monitoring.

options.label: D
options.text: `paste_revisions` table: (paste_id, revision_number, blob_key, edited_by, edited_at). Каждый edit = новый row + UPDATE `pastes.current_revision`. **Append-only revision history**.

sections.explanation: **Append-only revision history**. Edit = INSERT new revision (не UPDATE). Каждый revision blob immutable; если paste edited 100 times но content idential — single blob (CAS dedup). `current_revision` pointer для O(1) latest. UI rendering — `https://gist.github.com/user/abc/raw/{revision}/file` для immutable URLs.
sections.example: GitHub Gist хранит unlimited revisions через Git internally. Pastebin Pro поддерживает edit history. CodeSandbox, JSFiddle saves snapshots.
sections.when_to_apply: Content-sharing service с edit feature: gists, snippets с versioning.
sections.edge_cases: Storage cost grows linearly per edit. Garbage collection orphan blobs (revisions deleted, blob refs counted) — refcount tracking. Diff UI — server-side compute diff между revisions on demand.
sections.related: Q5 storage; Q20 diff; Q22 tiering.

blocks.question_text: Privacy modes: public / unlisted / private / password — как реализовать?

options.label: A
options.text: Поле `visibility` enum (`public`, `unlisted`, `private`, `password`); ACL check на view: `public` всегда OK, `unlisted` OK (просто не в listings/search), `private` требует owner auth.

sections.explanation: Single column `visibility` с 4 значениями (или separate flags). Listing/search filters `visibility='public'` only. `unlisted` accessible через direct URL но не listed → semi-private. `private` requires `user_id = current_user_id` check. `password` — hashed password (bcrypt) stored separately; user provides password → bcrypt verify → render. URL share works для всех — visibility check на view endpoint.
sections.example: GitHub Gist: public / secret (similar to unlisted). Pastebin: public / unlisted / private. Privatebin: password-protected всегда.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой content-sharing требует privacy controls. Single column `visibility` с 4 значениями (или separate flags).
sections.edge_cases: Search engines crawl `unlisted` если linked anywhere (e.g., в blog post). `private` paste shared с другим user — нужен share-as-link feature или email invite. Password rotation не trivial — paste content statyc, password change не invalidates existing access.
sections.related: Q21 architecture; Q26 auth.

options.label: B
options.text: Только public/private — два mode достаточно. Many use cases требуют unlisted (share с friend через URL без public listing) и password (group access без individual accounts).

sections.what_actually: Many use cases требуют unlisted (share с friend через URL без public listing) и password (group access без individual accounts).
sections.source_of_confusion: Simplifies UX без consideration. Many use cases требуют unlisted (share с friend через URL без public listing) и password (group access без individual accounts).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы only 2 modes, users используют hack — генерировать random long ID и считать его private (security through obscurity).
sections.how_it_should_be: 4 modes как индустриальный стандарт. Many use cases требуют unlisted (share с friend через URL без public listing) и password (group access без individual accounts).

options.label: C

blocks.question_text: Diff между paste revisions — на сервере или клиенте?

blocks.question_text: High-level architecture Pastebin — какие core services?

options.label: A
options.text: CDN edge → Load Balancer → API Gateway (auth + rate limit) → Create/Read services → Postgres metadata + S3 blob + Redis cache; Search service (ES); Abuse Service (DMCA + ClamAV);

Create Service: validate → anti-abuse scan → blob upload S3 → metadata insert Postgres → invalidate CDN. Read Service: Redis cache hit (95%) → S3 blob if miss → render with Pygments → cache in CDN. Search ES для public opt-in. Abuse Service async (Kafka events) для DMCA matching + ClamAV scan. OAuth GitHub primary login.

blocks.question_text: Storage tiering для Pastebin: Redis / S3 / Glacier?

options.label: A
options.text: Только S3 — единый tier. Hot pastes (top 0. Single-tier simplicity без cost optimization. Redis cache + S3 + Glacier.

sections.what_actually: Hot pastes (top 0.1% accessed daily) на S3 incur cost per GET (~$0.0004). 100M views/day = $40K/month только GET fees. Redis cache snizhaet это в 100×.
sections.source_of_confusion: Single-tier simplicity без cost optimization. Hot pastes (top 0.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы only S3, GET costs eat margin. Hot pastes (top 0.
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis cache + S3 + Glacier. Single-tier simplicity без cost optimization.

options.label: B
options.text: Hot tier Redis (top 1K viewed paste каждый день) → S3 Standard (active < 1 year) → S3 Glacier (archived > 1 year, rarely accessed).

sections.explanation: Three-tier. Redis caching popular pastes (LRU eviction) — sub-ms latency. S3 Standard для active (recent + occasionally accessed). Glacier для cold archive (older than 1 year + few views — paste created для backup, rarely read). Lifecycle policy: tag paste with `created_at` → S3 lifecycle rules: standard 1 year, glacier after. Cost: Standard $0.023/GB-month, Glacier $0.004 (5× cheaper).
sections.example: Netflix tiering (hot/warm/cold для streaming content). AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Pastebin.com использует похожую модель.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая system с power-law access distribution (80/20).
sections.edge_cases: Glacier restore 1-12 hours — bad UX для view. Mitigation: Glacier Deep Archive только для backup/compliance, не для active views. Edge case: viral old paste restored from Glacier → user wait.
sections.related: Q5 storage; Q14 expiration; Q29 cost.

options.label: C
options.text: Только Redis — keep all pastes в memory. 60 TB в Redis = $$$ (~$50M/month). Optimize latency без cost. Redis cache, не primary storage.

sections.source_of_confusion: Optimize latency без cost. 60 TB в Redis = $$$ (~$50M/month).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Redis-only, расходы > выручка. 60 TB в Redis = $$$ (~$50M/month).
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis cache, не primary storage. 60 TB в Redis = $$$ (~$50M/month).

options.label: D
options.text: Memcached + S3. Memcached менее feature-rich чем Redis (no persistence option, simpler eviction). Predecessor Redis выбор. Redis preferable для Pastebin.

sections.what_actually: Memcached менее feature-rich чем Redis (no persistence option, simpler eviction). Redis better choice для structured data + persistence.
sections.source_of_confusion: Predecessor Redis выбор. Memcached менее feature-rich чем Redis (no persistence option, simpler eviction).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Memcached, нет persistence (cache cold start после restart).
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis preferable для Pastebin. Memcached менее feature-rich чем Redis (no persistence option, simpler eviction).

Hit ratio target 95%+; origin sees only 5% traffic.

blocks.question_text: Anti-abuse для Pastebin — DMCA, malware, CSAM?

options.label: A
options.text: Multi-layer: (1) Real-time content scan на create (ClamAV для malware signatures, regex для credentials AWS/GitHub tokens, ML classifier для CSAM hashes PhotoDNA + NCMEC);

sections.explanation: Multi-layer defense. **ClamAV** scan для executable signatures (Windows PE, ELF, scripts с known malware patterns). **Regex/ML credential detection**: AWS `AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}`, GitHub `ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}` → auto-mask или reject. **PhotoDNA hash** + NCMEC database для CSAM (PhotoDNA из Microsoft — perceptual hash, detect re-uploads even if cropped). DMCA: rights holder submits hash, paste с matching content auto-rejected; existing matches purged + sent такой list to authorities если CSAM. Async re-scan через Kafka: новая ML model deployed → reprocess all past 30 days pastes.
sections.example: GitHub использует похожую infrastructure (Secret Scanning, Push Protection). Pastebin.com integrated с PhotoDNA. AWS S3 Object Scanning + ClamAV.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой user-content service: paste, comment, file upload.
sections.edge_cases: False positive: legitimate paste содержит pattern похожий на AWS key — needs human review queue. Adversarial: malware encoded в base64 в paste — ClamAV scans decoded variants. Privacy: scanning encrypted private content impossible (server can't read encrypted blobs — see 0bin/Privatebin client-side encryption).
sections.related: Q22 tiering (deleted goes to compliance archive); Q27 rate limit; Q28 monitoring.

options.label: B
options.text: Только user reporting — community moderates. Community moderation slow (часы-дни response). Open platform philosophy без responsibility. Multi-layer automated + user reports.

sections.source_of_confusion: Open platform philosophy без responsibility. Community moderation slow (часы-дни response).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только user reporting, в первый месяц accumulates 1000+ DMCA violations.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-layer automated + user reports. Community moderation slow (часы-дни response).

options.label: C
options.text: Captcha на каждый paste — abuse blocked. CAPTCHA blocks honest users (программные API calls, CLI tools). UX-killer. Rate limit + CAPTCHA conditional (only after anomaly).

sections.what_actually: CAPTCHA blocks honest users (программные API calls, CLI tools). Bot abuse circumvents (CAPTCHA-solving services $0.001/solve).
sections.source_of_confusion: UX-killer. CAPTCHA blocks honest users (программные API calls, CLI tools).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы CAPTCHA always, IDE plugins (Sublime PasteIt) перестают работать.
sections.how_it_should_be: Rate limit + CAPTCHA conditional (only after anomaly).

blocks.question_text: Authentication для Pastebin — OAuth + API tokens?

options.label: A
options.text: Только email/password authentication. Email/password — friction для signup (verify email, remember password). Traditional auth без modern preferences. OAuth primary + email backup.

sections.what_actually: Email/password — friction для signup (verify email, remember password). Modern users prefer OAuth (GitHub/Google) — faster onboarding.
sections.source_of_confusion: Traditional auth без modern preferences. Email/password — friction для signup (verify email, remember password).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы email-only, signup conversion drops vs OAuth competitors.
sections.how_it_should_be: OAuth primary + email backup. Email/password — friction для signup (verify email, remember password).

options.label: B
options.text: OAuth GitHub primary (most users developers) + email backup; API tokens generated через UI, stored hashed (bcrypt), revocable; format `pastebin_pat_{base62_random}` (prefix позволяет identify token type + scan-blocklist если accidentally leaked).

sections.explanation: OAuth GitHub primary — developers уже есть GitHub account, no signup friction. Email backup для non-developers. API tokens generated в settings UI; hashed (bcrypt с appropriate cost factor) before storage — DB breach не reveal tokens. Prefix `pastebin_pat_` (Personal Access Token convention from GitHub) — позволяет scan для accidentally committed tokens (via GitHub secret scanning, gitleaks). Token rotation: generate new + revoke old, audit log.
sections.example: GitHub PAT с prefix `ghp_`. Stripe API tokens `sk_live_*`. Slack tokens `xoxb-*` — prefix conventions.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой service requiring programmatic API access. OAuth GitHub primary — developers уже есть GitHub account, no signup friction.
sections.edge_cases: Token leakage: accidentally pushed to GitHub — secret scanning auto-revoke. Scopes (read-only, paste-create, paste-delete) — least privilege. Refresh tokens not standard for PAT (long-lived) vs OAuth (short-lived access + long-lived refresh).
sections.related: Q9 API contract; Q27 rate limit per token.

options.label: C
options.text: Полностью anonymous — no auth. Anonymous teryaet feature value (private pastes, per-user quotas, no edit history, no analytics). Privacy-first philosophy taken too far. Anonymous + auth oba modes.

sections.what_actually: Anonymous teryaet feature value (private pastes, per-user quotas, no edit history, no analytics). All pastes public — abuse magnet.
sections.source_of_confusion: Privacy-first philosophy taken too far. Anonymous teryaet feature value (private pastes, per-user quotas, no edit history, no analytics).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы anonymous-only, no premium tier monetization.
sections.how_it_should_be: Anonymous + auth oba modes. Anonymous teryaet feature value (private pastes, per-user quotas, no edit history, no analytics).

options.label: D
options.text: JWT с long expiration для всех auth. Long-lived JWT — revocation impossible without DB lookup (defeats stateless JWT). Stateless preferred без revocation. Session cookie для web + API tokens (hashed lookup) — combined.

sections.what_actually: Long-lived JWT — revocation impossible without DB lookup (defeats stateless JWT). Short-lived JWT requires refresh — complex для API clients.
sections.source_of_confusion: Stateless preferred без revocation. Long-lived JWT — revocation impossible without DB lookup (defeats stateless JWT).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы long JWT, leaked token valid до expiration (часы-дни).
sections.how_it_should_be: Session cookie для web + API tokens (hashed lookup) — combined.

blocks.question_text: Rate limit для Pastebin — anonymous vs auth?

options.label: A
options.text: Один global limit для всех. Global limit fails: anonymous abuse uses fraction of bandwidth, legitimate API clients (IDE plugins, monitoring tools) hit limit unfairly.

sections.what_actually: Global limit fails: anonymous abuse uses fraction of bandwidth, legitimate API clients (IDE plugins, monitoring tools) hit limit unfairly.
sections.source_of_confusion: Simplification без user differentiation. Global limit fails: anonymous abuse uses fraction of bandwidth, legitimate API clients (IDE plugins, monitoring tools) hit limit unfairly.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы global, legit API users blocked при anonymous DDoS.
sections.how_it_should_be: Per-user / per-IP differentiated. Global limit fails: anonymous abuse uses fraction of bandwidth, legitimate API clients (IDE plugins, monitoring tools) hit limit unfairly.

options.label: B
options.text: Только IP-based limit. Carriers/NAT share single IP → all users behind it count as one (block legit users). Simplistic networking model. User+IP composite.

sections.what_actually: Carriers/NAT share single IP → all users behind it count as one (block legit users). Conversely, attackers using residential proxies bypass IP limit.
sections.source_of_confusion: Simplistic networking model. Carriers/NAT share single IP → all users behind it count as one (block legit users).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы IP-only, mobile carriers' IPs hit limit на usage from 1000 users.
sections.how_it_should_be: User+IP composite. Carriers/NAT share single IP → all users behind it count as one (block legit users).

options.label: C
options.text: Tiered: anonymous IP-based 5 pastes/hour create, 100/hour view (Redis token bucket); authenticated user-based 25/hour create, 1000/hour view; Pro paid 250/hour create, unlimited view;

sections.explanation: **Tiered limits** по user class. Anonymous IP-based (extract real IP через `X-Forwarded-For` если behind LB) — 5 creates/hour (deter spam), 100 views/hour. Authenticated free — 25/hour create. Pro paid — 250/hour. Redis token bucket (atomic Lua script): `INCR + EXPIRE` checks remaining vs limit. Return 429 с `Retry-After` header. Differentiated allows API clients (auth) to operate while limiting abuse vectors (anonymous).
sections.example: GitHub rate limits (5000/hour authenticated, 60/hour unauth). Stripe API rate limits per API key. Cloudflare WAF rate limiting rules.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой public API с potential abuse. **Tiered limits** по user class.
sections.edge_cases: Distributed rate limit — Redis cluster shared across LB. Burst allowance (token bucket capacity > rate) для legit spikes. CAPTCHA escalation после repeated 429s для anonymous.
sections.related: Q21 architecture; Q25 anti-abuse; см. design-rate-limiter-interview Q12.

options.label: D
options.text: Распределённый rate limit через Cassandra. Cassandra не оптимальна для counter operations (LWT slow). Wrong tool selection. Redis для rate limits;

sections.what_actually: Cassandra не оптимальна для counter operations (LWT slow). Redis purpose-built для atomic INCR на microsecond latency.
sections.source_of_confusion: Wrong tool selection. Cassandra не оптимальна для counter operations (LWT slow).
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы Cassandra, rate-limit check latency 10ms vs Redis 0.5ms.
sections.how_it_should_be: Redis для rate limits; Cassandra для wide-column workloads.

blocks.question_text: Monitoring metrics для Pastebin?

options.label: A
options.text: Только uptime monitoring через external service. External pingdom-style видит only availability. External monitoring без internal. Both: external (synthetic) + internal (Prometheus).

sections.what_actually: External pingdom-style видит only availability. Latency, error rate, business metrics — internal только.
sections.source_of_confusion: External monitoring без internal. External pingdom-style видит only availability.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы только external, internal regression (slow query) недетектируется до full outage.
sections.how_it_should_be: Both: external (synthetic) + internal (Prometheus).

options.label: B
options.text: Только error logs через ELK. Logs без metrics → no aggregation, no alerts on threshold. Logs-only observability. Metrics (Prometheus) + logs (ELK) + traces (Jaeger).

sections.what_actually: Logs без metrics → no aggregation, no alerts on threshold. Logs answer 'что произошло', metrics — 'насколько часто, тренды'.
sections.source_of_confusion: Logs-only observability. Logs без metrics → no aggregation, no alerts on threshold.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы only ELK, alert on p99 latency > 200ms невозможен.
sections.how_it_should_be: Metrics (Prometheus) + logs (ELK) + traces (Jaeger).

options.label: C
options.text: Только business metrics через Mixpanel. Product analytics видит conversion, не operational health. Product manager mindset без SRE. Operational + product analytics обе.

sections.what_actually: Product analytics видит conversion, не operational health. Mixpanel не показывает API error rate, DB query latency.
sections.source_of_confusion: Product manager mindset без SRE. Product analytics видит conversion, не operational health.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы only Mixpanel, operational issues invisible до DAU drop.
sections.how_it_should_be: Operational + product analytics обе. Product analytics видит conversion, не operational health.

options.label: D
options.text: Multi-layer: Prometheus metrics (creation_latency_p99, view_latency_p99, cdn_hit_ratio, dmca_blocks_per_hour, expiration_gc_lag, abuse_block_rate, redis_memory_usage, postgres_replication_lag) + Grafana dashboards + alerts;

sections.explanation: **Three pillars observability**: metrics + logs + traces. Prometheus scrapes app + Redis + Postgres exporters; Grafana visualizes. Alert rules: creation_latency_p99 > 500ms 5 min → PagerDuty; cdn_hit_ratio < 80% → Slack warning; dmca_blocks spike → security team. Structured JSON logs к Loki (cheaper than ELK at scale). Distributed tracing через OpenTelemetry SDK — trace request от CDN edge через API через DB query. Business metrics в Mixpanel/Amplitude для product PM.
sections.example: Netflix Atlas + Spectator. Stripe internal observability stack (described in blog 2018). Cloudflare uses Prometheus + Grafana extensively.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая production service. **Three pillars observability**: metrics + logs + traces.
sections.edge_cases: Cardinality explosion: Prometheus labels (user_id) → millions series cost. Use exemplars для linking metric spike к specific trace. SLO burn rate alerts (multi-window) лучше threshold-based.
sections.related: Q3 SLO; Q21 architecture.

blocks.question_text: Cost optimization для Pastebin?

options.label: A
options.text: Storage: zstd compression 3-4× ratio → 70% storage saving (18 TB raw → 5-7 TB compressed = $115/month vs $415); S3 lifecycle policy moves old (>1 year) к Glacier (5× cheaper = $80→$15 для 5 TB cold);

sections.explanation: Multi-pronged cost reduction. **Compression**: zstd 3-4× on text → most impactful for blob cost. **Storage tiering**: S3 lifecycle policies auto-move 1-year-old к Glacier. **CDN cache** maximizes hit ratio (95%+) → origin bandwidth minimized. **R2 vs S3**: Cloudflare R2 priced $0.015/GB-month standard tier vs S3 $0.023 — 35% savings. Plus R2 no egress fee если served через Cloudflare (huge для CDN-heavy workload). Redis cache limited к hot set (LRU eviction) — not full corpus в memory.
sections.example: Reddit migration from S3 к R2 (2023, saved millions). Twitter использует похожий tiered approach.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая large-scale text/blob storage. Multi-pronged cost reduction.
sections.edge_cases: Snapshot encryption costs (KMS per-operation fee). Egress fee comparison: AWS $0.09/GB → Cloudflare R2 $0/GB (when behind CF). Reserved Instances для Postgres RDS — 60% cheaper.
sections.related: Q7 compression; Q22 tiering; Q23 CDN.

options.label: B
options.text: Просто использовать AWS — всё сразу cheap. AWS pricing не cheapest. AWS = default без cost analysis. Multi-cloud cost analysis + reserved capacity.

sections.what_actually: AWS pricing не cheapest. R2 / B2 (Backblaze) дешевле для cold storage. Reserved Instances + Spot Instances снижают compute cost 60-90%.
sections.source_of_confusion: AWS = default без cost analysis. AWS pricing не cheapest.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы AWS-default, монtly bill 2-3× против optimized stack.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-cloud cost analysis + reserved capacity. AWS pricing не cheapest.

options.label: C
options.text: Никаких оптимизаций — fast scale первый. Без cost monitoring monthly bill blows up быстро. Move-fast-break-things без financial discipline. Cost optimization continuously, не only когда crisis.

sections.what_actually: Без cost monitoring monthly bill blows up быстро. Early-stage саннятие 'scale first' приводит к operations крах когда runway ends.
sections.source_of_confusion: Move-fast-break-things без financial discipline. Без cost monitoring monthly bill blows up быстро.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы no optimization, $100K/month bill на $10M ARR Pastebin = unsustainable.
sections.how_it_should_be: Cost optimization continuously, не only когда crisis.

options.label: D
options.text: Только compression — другие optimizations не critical. Compression major но storage tiering + CDN + cloud provider selection collectively > compression saving. Single-knob optimization.

sections.what_actually: Compression major но storage tiering + CDN + cloud provider selection collectively > compression saving.
sections.source_of_confusion: Single-knob optimization. Compression major но storage tiering + CDN + cloud provider selection collectively > compression saving.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы compression-only, миссируем 50%+ saving from другие layers.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-pronged optimization. Compression major но storage tiering + CDN + cloud provider selection collectively > compression saving.

blocks.question_text: Антипаттерны Pastebin?

options.label: A
options.text: Хранение в S3, Postgres metadata, CDN, OAuth — это всё правильно, антипаттернов нет. Список реальных антипаттернов: blob в Postgres TEXT column, sync syntax highlighting per view, no GC for expired, sequential IDs, sync view counter row contention, no CDN, no Idempotency-Key (duplicate paste), plain API token in DB, no anti-abuse, single Postgres for blob.

sections.what_actually: Список реальных антипаттернов: blob в Postgres TEXT column, sync syntax highlighting per view, no GC for expired, sequential IDs, sync view counter row contention, no CDN, no Idempotency-Key (duplicate paste), plain API token in DB, no anti-abuse, single Postgres for blob.
sections.source_of_confusion: Overconfident в готовой архитектуре. Список реальных антипаттернов: blob в Postgres TEXT column, sync syntax highlighting per view, no GC for expired, sequential IDs, sync view counter row contention, no CDN, no Idempotency-Key (duplicate paste), plain API token in DB, no anti-abuse, single Postgres for blob.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 'no antipatterns', design review review без критики.
sections.how_it_should_be: Учиться на классических ошибках. Список реальных антипаттернов: blob в Postgres TEXT column, sync syntax highlighting per view, no GC for expired, sequential IDs, sync view counter row contention, no CDN, no Idempotency-Key (duplicate paste), plain API token in DB, no anti-abuse, single Postgres for blob.

options.label: B
options.text: Frequent antipatterns: blob в Postgres TEXT column (bloats DB), sync syntax highlighting per view (CPU waste), no GC for expired pastes (storage growth), sequential auto-increment IDs (enumeration vulnerability). Все эти — реальные мerge-blocking antipatterns.

sections.explanation: Все эти — реальные мerge-blocking antipatterns. **Blob в Postgres**: bloats heap → VACUUM expensive, replication slow. **Sync syntax highlight**: каждый view = Pygments CPU; cache rendered HTML в Redis. **No GC**: expired flag set но physical delete never → storage grows linearly. **Sequential IDs**: scrapers iterate /1 /2 → leak unlisted. **Sync view counter**: `UPDATE pastes SET views = views + 1 WHERE id=?` causes row lock on popular paste; async через Kafka + batch update. **No CDN**: origin handles 100M views/day. **No Idempotency-Key**: client retry creates duplicate. **Plain API token**: DB dump leaks; bcrypt hash. **No anti-abuse**: DMCA, malware, CSAM accumulate.
sections.example: Pastebin design reviews обычно identify все эти. Code review checklist для content-sharing services.
sections.when_to_apply: Design interview: identify антипаттерны in proposed architecture. Production audit на legacy systems.
sections.edge_cases: Single антипаттерн может оперативно survive — combination kills service. Order priority: durability/security > correctness > performance > cost. Антипаттерны накапливаются — refactor sprint раз в quarter.
sections.related: Все Q1-Q29 covered fix для each antipattern.

options.label: C
options.text: Только sequential IDs — другие OK для small scale. Все listed bite в production. Tolerates antipatterns до scale crisis. Address antipatterns proactively. Sync view counter создаёт row lock даже на 10 QPS popular paste. Если бы 'OK for small', technical debt accrues — refactor более expensive позже.

sections.what_actually: Все listed bite в production. Sync view counter создаёт row lock даже на 10 QPS popular paste. No CDN incurs bandwidth cost from day 1.
sections.source_of_confusion: Tolerates antipatterns до scale crisis. Все listed bite в production.
sections.if_it_were_true: Если бы 'OK for small', technical debt accrues — refactor более expensive позже.
sections.how_it_should_be: Address antipatterns proactively. Все listed bite в production.

options.label: D
options.text: Antipatterns relevant только для billion-user scale. Most antipatterns matter на 1K-1M scale: GC for expired (storage cost), CDN (latency UX), Idempotency-Key (client correctness). Premature optimization fallacy. Most antipatterns relevant from initial deployment.
